svg.title: The Garden of Eight Eaves
svg.desc: An original Chinese fantasy garden illustration: a symmetrical eight-storey red timber pagoda with curved jade roofs, gilded brackets, carved balconies, lattice windows and sixteen lanterns. A gold-maned, antlered Chinese dragon coils behind and in front of the tower. Bamboo, sculptural pine trees, ornamental rocks, flowers, lotus pond, mist, clouds and a stone pathway complete the garden. Self-contained vector artwork with no raster images or external dependencies.
